page.notes: Greek φωστῆρες is uncertain; the Greek word in the scan is blurred. A small symbol before "Apostolus" is not transcribed; it appears to be a printer's mark. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout, so "cæsorum", "fanguine" and similar forms are normalised. No page number, running head or signature is printed.
